column1: # Finnish (fi) catalog. Same format as zh-hant.tsv:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
# (empty context = a plain UI string; `@id` = a command id; `@plural` = "one|other" forms;
# Clean-room: written from the meaning of VectorCraft's English labels in standard Finnish, using
# ordinary vector-illustration vocabulary (piirtoalusta, polku, ankkuripiste, viiva, täyttö,
# värimalli, liukuväri, leikkausmaski, taso). No other application's Finnish localisation resource,
# string table or product UI was consulted or copied, and no other catalog was used as a source;
# add entries the same way. AI-assisted (Claude Code); a native speaker checked it in the running
# app, but it has not been proofread line by line.
# Conventions: labels use sentence case; commands use the imperative (Avaa, Tallenna, Näytä).
# Plurals are one/other with the partitive singular after any number but 1 ("1 taso", "2 tasoa").
# Status and error messages (`@msg`) keep the case of their English first word, as they are often
# shown after "…: ". Left in English on purpose (`MENU_KEEP_AS_IS` in the tests): the product name,
# OpenType, the built-in workspace names and the bracketed perspective grid preset names.
# Every `fi-*` locale resolves here. Keep the placeholders ({name}), the trailing "…" and the
# leading/trailing spaces of fragments exactly as they are.
